profile.headline: Application Software Engineer at NVidia
profile.summary: Robotist who has investigated force-controlled compliant mobile manipulation including low-level force control, inverse dynamics-based control, and computer vision using 3D scanner. Also experienced embedded system software development of many different kinds of systems thoroughly from bootstrap to graphical user interface

positions.title: Graduate Research Assistant
positions.description:
Develop task/motion planner for a mobile humanoid robot.
Exploit Kinect sensor for object recognition and reaction.
Built a mobile robot with 3D scanner and internal force sensors to detect external forces.
Built 3D scanner with 2D LIDAR, which involved mechanical design and electronics.
Built an SPI interface for torque sensors including amplifier circuits and microcontroller programming.
Teleoperated Humanoid, Dreamer, a force-control robot which made by Meka Inc. with wirelessHART.
Implemented compliant control with the whole body control framework

company.name: The University of Texas at Austin

positions.title: Chief Software Engineer
positions.description:
* 3D NRT (Non-Real-Time) broadcasting technology demonstration in NAB 2010
    Implemented the new broadcasting standard on the deployed TV set for 2 months.
*  digital-to-analog TV converter box developement (DTT900 / DTT901)
    Ported uC/OS OS (Real-Time OS for CPUs with limited performance) on the custom embedded board
    with the LGDT1111 chip. Also, developed a MPEG2 TS processing engine, and GUI.
    Received 2008 International CES Innovations Design and Engineering Award.
*  Evaluated LGE’s SoC for digital-to-analog broadcast transition.
    A new SoC chip for preparing the transition from digital TV to analog TV in the U.S. in 2009
    Brought up the board with the new chip.
    Developed the evaluating and testing program for the chip and made the device drivers.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
* Developed very high-data rate digital subscriber line (VDSL) access multiplexer with L2 switch.
    Implemented a boot loader and initial boot up codes, and ported the embedded Linux on customized 
    embedded system boards with PowerPC processors, Motorola MPC860 and IBM 405GP.
    Wrote Linux device driver for the L2 switch chip, I2C controller and PCI bus controller.
*  Developed emergency management system for PABX (Private Automatic Branch eXchange)    
    Implemented the GUI program for controlling PABX in distance using MFC library.

publications.title: Human Body Part Multicontact Recognition and Detection Methodology
publications.publisher: IEEE International Conference on Robotics and Automation (ICRA 2017) · Mar 28, 2017

publications.title: Full-Body Collision Detection and Reaction with Omnidirectional Mobile Platforms: A Step Towards Safe Human-Robot Interaction

patents.title: Apparatus of processing an image and a method of processing thereof
Method for processing broadcast program information and broadcast receiver
patents.description: A method for processing program information and a broadcast receiver are disclosed. The method includes selecting a program from a service guide screen, identifying a group to which the selected program belongs, and displaying a group list of programs included in a signaling table that signals information of the identified group.
